item.description: The calculator allows you to convert cm to feet. To convert centimeters to feet, divide by 30.48. We are going to convert a distance d of 150 centimeters to feet. Distance d = 150 centimeters. 1 cm = 1 / 30.48 ft. d = 150 cm = 150 / 30.48 = 4.92 feet.
